r: Privacy Policy

Carezaar LLC (“Carezaar,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, store, and protect personal information when you access or use the Carezaar website, mobile applications, and related services (collectively, the “Platform”). This Privacy Policy applies to visitors, registered users, individuals seeking care (“Care Needers”), individuals providing care services (“Caregivers”), agencies, and other individuals who interact with the Platform. Capitalized terms not defined in this Privacy Policy have the meanings given to them in Carezaar’s Terms of Use.
1. . Information About Children

The Carezaar Platform is intended for individuals who are at least 18 years old. Individuals under 18 may not register for or independently use the Platform. Carezaar may process information about a child who needs care when an adult parent, legal guardian, or other authorized representative provides that information for a legitimate care-related purpose through the Platform. The adult providing the information is responsible for ensuring that they have the authority and any required permissions to submit it. We do not knowingly permit individuals under 18 to create their own accounts. If we learn that an individual under 18 has created an account or provided personal information in violation of this Policy, we will take appropriate steps to address the information and account in accordance with applicable law. For questions or requests concerning personal information about a child, please contact Carezaar using the contact information provided in this Privacy Policy.
2. How We Collect Information

For purposes of this Privacy Policy, “Personal Information” means information that identifies, relates to, describes, or could reasonably be linked to an identified or identifiable individual. The types of information we collect depend on how you use the Carezaar Platform and the features available to you.

“De-identified or Aggregated Information” means information that has been processed so that it is not reasonably capable of identifying an individual, either alone or in combination with other information reasonably available to us. We may collect Personal Information directly from you, automatically through your use of the Platform, and from third parties where permitted by applicable law. The categories of information we collect and the purposes for which we use them are described below.
3. Information Provided by Caregivers

When you register as a Caregiver on the Carezaar Platform, we may collect personal information that you provide, including your name, email address, phone number, location, profile photograph, professional experience, education, skills, qualifications, certifications (if voluntarily provided), availability, and care service preferences. Carezaar uses this information to create and maintain caregiver profiles, facilitate matching with Care Needers, enable communication between users, and provide Platform services. At launch, Carezaar does not collect Social Security numbers, driver’s license numbers, criminal background reports, banking information, or payment card information as part of caregiver registration. Carezaar does not independently conduct background checks or verify professional credentials unless expressly stated otherwise. Caregivers are responsible for ensuring that the information they provide is accurate and that they meet any applicable legal requirements for the services they offer.
4. Information Provided by Care Needers

When you register as a Care Needer on the Carezaar Platform, we may collect personal information you provide, including your name, email address, phone number, location, profile photograph, care preferences, requested services, scheduling needs, and other information relevant to identifying suitable Caregivers. Because Carezaar is a care-matching platform, Care Needers may also provide care-related information, including assistance needed with daily activities, mobility or accessibility requirements, relevant health conditions, and other information necessary to describe their care needs. We use this information to facilitate AI-assisted matching, identify potentially suitable Caregivers, support communication, and provide Platform functionality. Care-related information may be sensitive and will be processed and shared in accordance with this Privacy Policy and applicable law. Carezaar does not collect payment card information or process payments for caregiving services at launch. Carezaar does not provide medical diagnosis, treatment, or clinical assessments through the Platform.
5. Information Provided by Family Members, Representatives, and Agencies

When you register or use Carezaar as a family member, authorized representative, or any care agency, we may collect information such as your name, email address, phone number, organization name, professional role, location, staffing needs, job postings, scheduling preferences, and other information necessary to facilitate matching. Family members and authorized representatives may provide care-related information about individuals for whom they are seeking care, provided they have the legal authority or appropriate permission to share that information. Agencies may provide information about staffing requirements, available positions, required qualifications, work schedules, and other details relevant to connecting with potential Caregivers. Carezaar uses this information to operate the Platform, facilitate matching, support communication, and provide account-related services. Carezaar does not collect banking information, Social Security numbers, criminal background reports, or payment card information as part of standard account registration at launch.
6. Information You Provide When Contacting Us

When you contact Carezaar for customer support, submit feedback, report a concern, or communicate with us by email or through the Platform, we may collect your name, contact information, the content of your communication, any attachments you provide, and information reasonably necessary to respond to your request.
We use this information to respond to inquiries, provide support, investigate reported issues, improve the Platform, and maintain records of our communications where appropriate.
7. Messages and User-Submitted Content

When you create a profile, send messages, submit a job posting, upload a photograph, or otherwise provide content through the Carezaar Platform, we may store and process that content to operate the Platform and provide its features.

Depending on your account settings and the feature you use, certain profile information and content may be visible to Care Needers, Caregivers, agencies, or other users with whom you connect or share information.

You should not submit sensitive personal information about yourself or another individual in public-facing profile fields or messages unless it is necessary and appropriate for the intended purpose. You are responsible for ensuring that you have the rights and permissions necessary to submit information about another person.
Carezaar may retain and process submitted content as described in this Privacy Policy, including for account management, matching, security, legal compliance, and dispute resolution.
8. Technical and Support Information

When you use the Platform or contact us for technical support, we may collect information you provide and certain technical information made available through your use of the Platform, such as your device type, operating system, application version, and diagnostic information, where applicable.

We use this information to troubleshoot technical issues, maintain security, improve performance, and support the operation of the Platform. The specific technical information collected depends on the features and technologies used by Carezaar.
9. Information Collected Through Platform Features
Carezaar may collect additional information when you use a specific Platform feature, submit a form, participate in a promotion, or interact with a feature that expressly requests information.

Before or when collecting additional information, we will provide relevant information about the collection where required by applicable law. We use such information for the purposes explained when it is collected and as otherwise described in this Privacy Policy.
10. Care-Related Information and Privacy

Carezaar collects and processes care-related information voluntarily provided by Care Needers, family members, authorized representatives, and other users to facilitate matching between individuals seeking care, Caregivers. This information may include descriptions of care needs, assistance required with daily activities, mobility and accessibility requirements, scheduling preferences, and relevant health-related information. Carezaar uses this information for purposes related to providing the Platform, including facilitating matching, supporting communication between users, and helping users evaluate potential care arrangements. Certain care-related information may qualify as sensitive personal information under applicable privacy laws. Carezaar will handle such information in accordance with applicable legal requirements and the practices described in this Privacy Policy. Carezaar does not use the Platform to provide medical diagnosis, treatment, or clinical assessments. Users should provide only the care-related information reasonably necessary for their intended purposes and must have appropriate authority to share information about another individual.
11. Your Choice to Provide Information

You may choose not to provide certain information requested by Carezaar. However, if information is necessary to create an account, complete your profile, use a particular feature, or facilitate a requested match, choosing not to provide it may limit your ability to use that feature or receive relevant matches.

Where information is optional, we will identify it as optional when reasonably practicable. We will not treat optional profile information as a mandatory registration requirement unless the applicable feature or law requires it.
12. Account Closure and Data Deletion
You may request closure of your Carezaar account through the account settings, where available, or by contacting Carezaar at info@carezaar.com.

Closing your account does not necessarily result in the immediate deletion of all personal information. Carezaar may retain certain information where reasonably necessary for legitimate business purposes, security, legal compliance, dispute resolution, or other purposes permitted by applicable law.
When personal information is no longer required for the purposes for which it was collected, Carezaar will delete or de-identify it in accordance with its retention practices and applicable law.
Where applicable law provides you with rights to access, correct, delete, or otherwise control your personal information, you may exercise those rights as described in this Privacy Policy.
13. California Residents

California residents may have additional privacy rights under applicable California law, depending on the circumstances. These rights may include the right to know about certain personal information collected, used, or disclosed; request deletion or correction; and opt out of certain sales or sharing of personal information where applicable.

To submit a privacy request, contact Carezaar at info@carezaar.com. We will review and respond to requests in accordance with applicable law. Carezaar will not discriminate against individuals for exercising privacy rights available to them under applicable law.

Additional information about the categories of personal information Carezaar collects, the purposes for which it is used, and the circumstances in which it may be disclosed is provided in this Privacy Policy.
14. International Users and Location of Processing

Carezaar is designed to facilitate connections between Care Needers, Caregivers. The availability of the Platform may vary by location. Personal information may be processed or stored in the United States or other countries where Carezaar or its service providers operate, depending on the services and technologies used. Where personal information is transferred internationally, Carezaar will take steps required by applicable law to protect that information. Privacy laws may differ depending on your location. Carezaar will handle personal information in accordance with applicable legal requirements.
15. Contact Information
Carezaar LLC welcomes your questions, comments, and concerns regarding this Privacy Policy or our handling of personal information.
To contact us about privacy-related matters, please email:
Carezaar LLC Email:
info@carezaar.com
Please do not include unnecessary sensitive personal information in your email. We will review and respond to privacy inquiries as appropriate and in accordance with applicable law.
16. Changes to This Privacy Policy

Carezaar may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our Platform, information-handling practices, business operations, or applicable legal requirements. When we make material changes, we will update the “Last Revised” date and provide notice through the Platform, by email, or through another appropriate method when required by applicable law. Any updated Privacy Policy will identify its effective date. Where applicable law requires your consent to a change in our collection, use, or disclosure of personal information, we will obtain that consent before implementing the change as required by law. We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically to understand how Carezaar handles personal information. If you have questions about an update, you may contact us using the contact information provided in this Policy.
